item.title: Are the Three Musketeers allergic to muskets?(2014)
item.description:
📝 Share This Tweet Share on Facebook Share on LinkedIn Share on Reddit HomeNews Oxford News blog Stuart Gillespie 21 Jan 2014 The BBC's new drama series The Musketeers – adapted from Alexandre Dumas' novel Les Trois Mousquetaires – made its debut on Sunday evening. Plus one element that is markedly more prevalent than in the book itself: gunfire. Even when his heroes are mobilized, Dumas remains reluctant to give his musketeers their muskets.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ox.ac.uk/news/arts-blog/are-three-musketeers-allergic-muskets
